confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Los Cabos resort pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, beer, and coffee anchors are the more reliable ones. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Cabo San Lucas has few hostels and its hotel rates vary widely by season, property, and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker. The FX observation is the RBA homepage figure for 15 October 2026 as reported in search results; I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mexican Pacific resort towns with heavy tourist demand, such as Puerto Vallarta, used as the base for local-venue prices. Cabo's resort premium is applied to restaurant and hotel anchors. July 2026 is treated as a shoulder-to-low season for accommodation.
